A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ARM study. Their text, equations, tables, figures and appendices support reliable comparison despite extensive reformatting and relocation.

before.justification: V1 reports original subjectivity-detection experiments and human evaluations of rewrites and explanations in Tables 1–4 and Appendix A.7.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments in Tables 1–5 and additionally reports agreement between the author annotators in Appendix A.6.

M1.justification: ARM retains the same claim-rewriting procedure, prompts, explanations and feedback signals. The newly specified decoding temperature documents implementation rather than establishing a changed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same StorySumm stories, LLM summaries, 15 human-written summaries and synthetic objective/subjective variants. No dataset, domain, population or test scenario is added.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same fine-tuned Llama and Claude/GPT prompting baselines. V1 Table 5 and v2 Table 3 contain the same rewrite comparisons; 'inconsist.' becomes 'unfaith.' without changing the corresponding prompt.

E3.justification: Sampling, annotation design, benchmark metrics and training budgets remain unchanged. Temperature zero and two A100 GPUs are newly disclosed settings. The added agreement statistics concern existing author annotations and do not establish a revised evaluation design.

E4.justification: Appendix A.6 adds a quantitative check of consistency between the authors' labels before adjudication. Prompt/model sensitivity, annotation-position and decoy checks, and recall by ambiguity type remain unchanged; the prompt analysis moves from Appendix A.7 to Section 5.3.

E5.justification: V2 newly reports pre-adjudication annotation reliability using raw agreement and chance-corrected Cohen's kappa; v1 only describes coding and adjudication. The 10,000-trial bootstrap procedure remains unchanged, with no additional runs or seeds reported.

E6.justification: V2 Appendix A.6 adds 89% author agreement and Cohen's kappa of 0.53. Existing table and plotted results are unchanged, including 36.36% versus 57.45% agreement in v1 Table 3/v2 Table 4 and all relocated prompt-comparison scores.

T1.justification: The four faithfulness statuses, rewrite formalism and explanation-score formulas retain the same mathematical content. Changes to equation displays and numbering do not introduce new definitions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: accommodating ambiguity, extending StorySumm annotations and using ARM for evaluation. The headline 21% absolute improvement in annotator agreement is unchanged.

C2.justification: A new Limitations section acknowledges restricted generalization from the small dataset and reproducibility limits arising from annotator variation and subjectivity. Existing result interpretations remain. The expanded Ethics Statement also asserts 'no risks,' despite the retained Figure 5 warning about disturbing content.

D1.justification: V2 specifies temperature zero for rewriting in Section 3.1 and two A100 GPUs for fine-tuning in Section 4.4, details absent from v1. It also identifies the IRB protocol and clarifies research-use permission for StorySumm. The dataset release link remains unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 6 adds Mishra et al. (2024) and Ramprasad et al. (2024), connecting the work to ambiguity in real-world QA and dialogue summarization. V2 also resolves the 'yao' placeholder with Yao et al. (2023) and its reference. Overall positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: Most scientific prose remains unchanged. V2 moves Appendix A.7 into Results Section 5.3, standardizes inconsistency-related labels as unfaithfulness, makes limited language corrections, and adds or expands the closing ethics, limitations and acknowledgments sections.

P2.justification: The main text changes from a single-column preprint to a two-column layout, with a reformatted author block and extensively resized or repositioned tables, figures and appendix prompt boxes. V1 Table 5 becomes main-text Table 3, and the annotation screenshots occupy separate pages.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly improves transparency through annotation-agreement statistics, decoding and hardware details, and explicit limits on generalization and reproducibility. Related-work context also improves while the principal experiments remain unchanged. The new blanket 'no risks' statement is poorly qualified given Figure 5's warning about disturbing content, but does not outweigh these limited gains.
